title: Page 62
transc:
Washington Apr 14 / 64
Geo D Sheldon
Harriet for Knox unity Judah desires that
about plug half torch welch iron at
farmer be removed to barber zebra it
is reported that there is enough at
famish to lay about harrow plunge spoons
of wedlock the vintons quadrant will send
for it as it is wanted Jordan
TT Eckert


Ft. Monroe April 14 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Judah zebra pandora Kants is a
most excellent officer but all my pacific
paradises rank him unity no officer ordered
here has as yet wicked yoke Knave
Geo D Sheldon


Washington April 14 / 64
Geo D Sheldon
for Knave your wick respecting negotiations with 
Commissioner old for the exchange of prisoners
of war has been referred to me
for my orders unity until examined be
me & my orders there in are
received by you decline all further negotiations
Jersey
Geo D Sheldon
